name: Tenaga Nasional Berhad
overview: 今年 TNB 通过子公司 TNB Renewables 与 IOI 旗下 Luminous 及 CSP 500MW 组成联营体，开发 500MWac 太阳能光伏及 250MW/1,000MWh 电池储能项目，并供应绿色电力给企业客户；同时集团继续精简业务，将两家休眠子公司 TNB Properties 和 TNP Construction 自愿清盘。
overview_en: This year TNB, through subsidiary TNB Renewables, formed a joint venture with IOI's Luminous and CSP 500MW to develop a 500MWac solar PV project with a 250MW/1,000MWh battery energy storage system and supply green electricity to corporate customers; meanwhile the group continued business rationalisation by voluntarily winding up two dormant subsidiaries, TNB Properties and TNP Construction.

segments.name: 发电
segments.note: 通过联营公司开发大型太阳能光伏及电池储能项目，向企业客户供应绿色电力。
segments.note_en: Developing a large-scale solar PV and battery energy storage project through a joint venture to supply green electricity to corporate customers.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: TNB Renewables 与 Luminous Aspect 及 CSP 500MW 签署联营股东协议，分别持股 70%、25%、5%，成立 Bahau Energy Ventures 开发 500MWac 太阳能光伏及 250MW/1,000MWh 电池储能项目。
actions.text_en: TNB Renewables signed a joint venture shareholders' agreement with Luminous Aspect and CSP 500MW, holding 70%, 25% and 5% respectively, to incorporate Bahau Energy Ventures for the development of a 500MWac solar PV project with a 250MW/1,000MWh battery energy…

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 集团进行业务精简，将休眠子公司自愿清盘。
segments.note_en: The group carried out business rationalisation by voluntarily winding up dormant subsidiaries.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 全资子公司 TNB Properties Sdn. Bhd.（已休眠）于 2026 年 6 月 4 日股东决议自愿清盘，作为集团精简休眠子公司的举措。
actions.text_en: Wholly owned dormant subsidiary TNB Properties Sdn. Bhd. resolved on 4 June 2026 to be voluntarily wound up as part of the group's rationalisation of dormant subsidiaries.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 TNP Construction Sdn. Bhd.（已休眠）于 2026 年 5 月 25 日股东决议自愿清盘，作为集团精简休眠子公司的举措。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly owned dormant subsidiary TNP Construction Sdn. Bhd. resolved on 25 May 2026 to be voluntarily wound up as part of the group's rationalisation of dormant subsidiaries.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过联营公司新增太阳能光伏及电池储能开发业务，并依据 Corporate Renewable Energy Supply Scheme 向企业客户供应绿色电力。
model_changes.text_en: Added solar PV and battery energy storage development business through a joint venture, supplying green electricity to corporate customers under the Corporate Renewable Energy Supply Scheme.
